Celular Listo for Android · Help

A checklist to leave a phone the way its owner needs it.

Sooner or later it falls to one of us to set up a relative's phone, and finding each option gets harder every time. Celular Listo goes through an Android phone's settings, shows how each one stands and gives the steps to change it. It is made above all for an older adult's phone. It changes nothing by itself, needs no account and no internet, and everything stays on the phone.

Getting startedThe statesThe stepsYour listQuestionsContact

Getting started

  1. Open Celular Listo on the phone you want to go through and pick who it is for: Older adult, Essentials, Accounts and security or Peace of mind. You can change it later, or build your own selection.
  2. Summary shows how much is left and where to start. To do lists what remains: first what the phone reported, then what only a person can look at.
  3. Tap a check to see what was found, why it matters and how to change it.

The three states

  • Needs a fix: Celular Listo read the setting and it differs from what the list recommends. You decide whether to change it; Keep it records that you saw it.
  • Check by hand: Android does not let an app read that setting. Follow the steps and tap Mark as done.
  • Fine: it is as the list recommends, or you confirmed it, with the date you did.

Every time you come back from the phone's settings, Celular Listo reads again.

The steps and the button

  • Each check has numbered steps, with the menus to follow and what to tap in bold. They are written for the phone's brand when we know it.
  • The button opens the closest settings screen the phone allows. If it opens another one, under it there is a word to search for in the settings, with a button that copies it.
  • You can write a note on each check (for example, which apps were given a lock).

Your list, for the next phone

  • Under More you can add checks of your own, something only your family needs.
  • Save list writes the profile, your own checks and your notes to a small file. On the new phone, install Celular Listo and use Load list. Done marks do not travel: the new phone is gone through again.
  • Share result hands the result over as text, to help from far away.

Questions

Does it change settings or remove apps?

No. Celular Listo only shows and explains; you make every change yourself in the phone's settings, and you can undo it there.

Is it an antivirus?

No. It is a checklist. It does not scan files or apps, and it blocks nothing.

Which phones does it work on?

Android 10 or later with Google Play. The steps are written for stock Android (Pixel, Motorola and similar), for Xiaomi and for Samsung. On other brands the general steps apply, and the button goes to the settings search with the word copied.

Why are some checks "by hand"?

Because Android does not allow an app to read that setting (for example, whether the Google account has 2-Step Verification). There Celular Listo gives the steps and you confirm.

Does it send anything to anyone?

No. The app has no internet permission. The privacy policy says it in full.

Contact

If a button opens the wrong screen or a step does not match your phone, tell us the brand and model at contact@neorgon.com: that is how it gets corrected for everyone.
